title: BLOWN GLASS & WIRE PENDANT LIG...
reason: Under-described Venetian style cranberry glass and brass wire hanging lantern that could be vintage Murano, but no maker's mark seen so it may be a modern copy.
findings: One photo only. Venetian (Murano style) caged lantern: pink or cranberry tinted blown glass body with an optic diamond-moulded surface, brass wire ribs running down to a point at the base, a cluster of three or four cranberry marbled glass knops at the top held by brass nuts and bolts, a brass hanging ring, white cord and a white ceramic ceiling cup. A glossy dark purple leaf shaped patch sits on the front of the body (applied glass leaf or a dark reflection, unclear). No maker's label, signature or mark is visible, so any Murano or Venetian attribution rests on style alone and it could equally be a modern import. The only writing is a handwritten paper tag reading S178/4 (house tag). The title does not say Venetian or cranberry. The 28 cm height cannot be checked from the photo.
condition: No chips, cracks or missing parts visible from the single angle shown. Brass wire has an aged patina. Inside, underside, lamp holder and wiring are not shown and are untested.
rescore_note: Heavy cranberry optic glass and brass wire caged lantern in the Venetian style, but unmarked and could equally be a modern copy, with wiring untested; scored on the realistic mix of vintage Murano and modern import.
